review.scope: Drive service-only runtime credential staging repair after actual systemd 0440 startup failure. Review RuntimeDirectory 0700 and install 0600 ExecStartPre, unchanged strict reader and executable 6ea7566b, recovery of the original failed request, and exact deployment-artifact/source binding. Existing Google/file access approval is not reopened. No scientific analysis or patient execution.
findings: Staging is correct: ExecStartPre without '+' prefix runs as User=research-drive, so both runtime copies are owned by the service UID at mode 0600 inside the 0700 RuntimeDirectory, satisfying the unchanged protected_read validator (regular file, O_NOFOLLOW, owner in {root, self}, no group/other bits) without relaxing it; the 0440 root originals in /etc remain rejected for direct reads as intended.

Fail-closed startup: $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY is available to ExecStartPre, and a failed install aborts the unit, so a missing/unreadable credential stops the broker instead of starting it unvalidated; systemd credential files are already restricted to the service user, so no wider identity gains read access.

No persistent credential artifact: systemd removes and recreates the RuntimeDirectory across service stops, so staged copies are ephemeral and cannot be pre-seeded with symlinks; UMask=0077 plus install -m 0600 leaves no readable creation window; root originals are untouched.

Authority preserved: the change is confined to the unit file; ProtectSystem=strict, NoNewPrivileges, PrivateTmp, RestrictAddressFamilies, resource limits, the drive.file single-scope check, registry/alias restrictions and the peer-UID caller check are unchanged, and nothing reopens or widens the existing Google/file-access approval.

Recovery semantics sound: startup failed in protected_read before any request was served, so no evidence folder exists for the first request; resubmitting the identical request_id proceeds fresh, while intent.json operation/alias conflict checks and the reserved 'upload-' namespace prevent replacing an uncertain collection with a fresh ID, and Restart=on-failure restarts only the serve loop without retrying transfers.

Binding action (non-blocking): source-only review cannot attest that the installed /opt tree equals 6ea7566b or that the deployed unit equals this file; pin this unit file at commit e317f6157d2f75c90938ca9fbfbb4436e30df39b as the exact deployment artifact, and verify the runtime receipt implementation_sha256 against 6ea7566b's drive_evidence.py after installation, without reopening the file-access grant.

Suggestion: research-system-drive.socket was not supplied; serve()'s LISTEN_PID/LISTEN_FDS and getsockname checks fail closed on a mismatched socket path, but the unchanged socket unit should be included in the pinned artifact set so the /run/research-system/drive.sock binding is reviewable.

disposition: Concur within exact implementation scope. Scientific acceptance and reserved authority remain separate.
optional_suggestions: Deferred; intake invoked beneath existing private 0700 parent. No additional infrastructure expansion.
